svg.title: Two ways to read the memory
svg.desc: Left, the representation: plain code, no model call. It takes the 33 conclusions closest to the question by embedding, fills up to 100 with the newest, sorts each level by when it was said, and prints them with their times; patterns are printed without a time. In the first server run it returned the pescatarian row dated 20 July, a stale deduction about vegetarian food dated 14 March, and a stale pattern marked 'high' with no date. Right, the dialectic: an agent. Before its first call the code fetches the 25 closest explicit conclusions and the 25 closest derived ones; at the default level it may use tools for up to 5 rounds; it writes an answer. Its prompt has two rules for two values of one fact: ask the user which is correct, and the more recent one supersedes. In the first run it made one call and answered: pescatarian, the peanut allergy, no shellfish for Lena, coeliac Jonas. Either output goes to the answering prompt.
svg.text: Two ways to read the memory
On the same store: a rule that returns conclusions with their times, or an agent that reads them and answers.
